Definition: neuter singular of the same as G3062; something remaining (adverbially):--besides, finally, furthermore, (from) henceforth, moreover, now, + it remaineth, then.
BiblicalUsage: loipón means finally, what remains, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Philippians 3:1, "Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord"; and in 1 Thessalonians 4:1, "Furthermore then we beseech you". In 2 Timothy 4:8, "Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe finally is Paul's favourite word for the end of a letter and the start of the Christian life — finally, brethren, rejoice, walk, and receive the crown.
